name: c14-office-dashboard
prompt: Exactly as in the image: the office at golden hour, the woman in the navy pinstripe kurta with the lanyard beside a slim man in a charcoal polo shirt, both looking at a large monitor showing a pale green dashboard with a rising line chart, stacked bars and cards, warm low light across the desk. She traces the rising line on the screen with her pen, he nods and says something, they both smile, and she leans back a little. Locked-off camera, no movement. Sound: a quiet office, a short warm laugh, a pen tapping the desk. No text, no logos, no lettering anywhere. Photorealistic live action, 35 mm, natural skin and fabric.
use: SC-158: one shot of the demo film, image to video from its keyframe
